Steps

How We Work

Schedule a Pick-up

1

Step 1

Schedule a Pick-up

To offer you a convenient way of donating, we have planned to pick up items from your doorstep. When you "book a pick-up," our volunteers will come to your address and pick up the essentials at the scheduled time.

Donate at Your Doorstep

2

Step 2

Donate at Your Doorstep

Making a donation has never been so easy. Finding an orphanage and commuting there demands the availability of time and resources. But that should not stop you from making a move. collect your donations, and distribute them to needy children.

Be Someone’s reason to Smile

3

Step 3

Be Someone’s reason to Smile

Your determination to do something for the vulnerable section will add you to the list of changemakers. No matter how small your contribution is, it will always bring about a change in the community for a good cause.
